parsed.note_claim: The Good Friday Agreement gives the UK Secretary of State for Northern Ireland power to call a border poll, including a duty if a majority for unity appears likely.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: 1. The Secretary of State may by order direct the holding of a poll for the purposes of section 1 on a date specified in the order. 2. Subject to paragraph 3, the Secretary of State shall exercise the power under paragraph 1 if at any time it appears likely to him that a majority of those voting would express a wish that Northern Ireland should cease to be part of the United Kingdom and form part of a united Ireland.
parsed.reason: The page reproduces the Good Friday Agreement's Schedule 1, which explicitly grants the Secretary of State the power to call a poll and a duty to do so when a majority for unity appears likely, directly substantiating the note's claim.
